mentions.name: 7DFPS 2025 game jam entry
mentions.description: A first-person shooter entry created for the 7DFPS Game Jam, built with Godot and released as an HTML5 web build on itch.io. The project served as practice for learning 3D modelling and the Godot engine.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I tried the 7DFPS Game Jam this month, trying to learn a little more 3D modelling, as well as Godot. It was my first time using the engine to produce a HTML5 build.

https://danbolt.itch.io/7dfps-2025
